description.value: Earth Club Factory is a long-running community institution on Denman Island, weaving together a bistro/cafe, a 20-bed hostel, performance venue, art gallery, and organic food buying club within a 110-year-old farmhouse property. A touring cyclist arrives to find not just coffee and grilled food but a full cultural hub — on-site coffee roasting, live music nights, a mosaic outdoor kitchen, and a cob oven speak to the deeply community-rooted character of the place. The property sits centrally to the Denman ferry and village, and the owners have explicitly cultivated a welcoming stop for cyclists exploring what they describe as easy, rewarding island terrain.

address.value: 3806 Denman Road, Denman Island, BC V0R 1T0

The Getting Here page explicitly names Denman and Hornby Islands as popular cycling destinations with easy terrain, and notes on-site camping for cyclists — making this a clear cycling-tourism fit.
